title: Dental PPO Plans Benefit Services Note: Waiting-Period Denials after a Change to a Richer Plan
content:
Dental PPO Plans — waiting-period denials of services the new plan covers and the prior plan did not.

**Situation governed.** A claim line that stands denied for the waiting period, dated on or after the date the enrollment changed to a plan that covers the line's service class while the plan it held before did not, may be reprocessed on the person's earlier coverage. The new-plan-wait reprocessing rule fixes the corrected patient share of such a line.

**Line under reprocessing.** The enrollment's most recently decided line whose decision is a denial carrying the waiting-period remark. Where several such lines share that latest decision date, this rule is not used and each is reprocessed under the base rules; where that line is dated before the plan change date, this rule is not used.

**Outside this rule (reprocessed under the base rules):** a line whose service class the prior plan also covered; a line dated before the plan change; a line that a frequency or age limit would deny; a bridge, denture or implant replacing a tooth extracted before the coverage effective date; a line on a plan that banks rollover dollars whose payment would be limited by the remaining annual maximum; a line of a child whose subscriber has two or more children enrolled on individual exchange enrollments; and a line on an account with more than three enrolled persons.

**Carried onto the corrected decision.** The denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, service class, tooth, extraction date, dates, benefit year, billed amount, allowed amount, alternate allowance and other-carrier payment.

**When the patient share is fixed.** A reprocessed new-plan-wait line's patient share is fixed only after the person's most recently decided line denied as not eligible, when it is dated earlier than this line in the same benefit year on a date on which the enrollment was in force while its funding billing account was in a premium grace period, has been reprocessed. So long as that earlier not-eligible line still stands denied, this line's patient share is not yet fixed.

**Tool: `reprocess_upgrade_denial_9a74d03b`.**

| Block | Contract |
|---|---|
| Capability | Reprocesses one Dental PPO claim line that stands denied for the new waiting period that followed a change of the enrollment to a richer plan: books a corrected decision that replaces the denial, carrying over the denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, tooth, extraction date, dates of service and receipt, benefit year, billed, allowed and alternate allowances and other-carrier payment, and recording the corrected deductible, coinsurance, total plan payment and patient share with the reprocessed remark (ADJUSTED_REPROCESSED) and today's decision date. In the same write any deductible taken is posted to the person's deductible and the payment or patient share is posted to the accumulator named by the accumulator track. Afterwards the member's Explanation of Benefits shows the corrected decision and the accumulators reflect it. |
| Invocation | Agent-side: the agent unlocks `reprocess_upgrade_denial_9a74d03b` and then calls it. |
| `denied_claim_line_id` | Reference number of the denied claim-line decision being replaced, as returned by the dental claim-line lookup for the member's enrollment |
| `deductible_applied` | Deductible taken on the corrected decision; USD, 2 decimals, rounded half up; 0.00 when none |
| `coinsurance_pct` | Coinsurance percentage the corrected decision pays at; whole number 0 to 100 |
| `plan_paid` | Corrected total plan payment; USD, 2 decimals, rounded half up; 0.00 when nothing is paid |
| `member_responsibility` | Corrected patient share; USD, 2 decimals, rounded half up |
| `accumulator_track` | `annual_maximum` (plan payment counts against the annual maximum); `pediatric_in_network` (person receives the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment and the line is from an in-network practice: nothing posted to the annual maximum, patient share posted to the pediatric out-of-pocket accumulator); `pediatric_out_of_network` (person receives that treatment and the line is from an out-of-network practice: nothing posted to either) |
| Return | `status` ("reprocessed"), `dental_claim_line_id` (new corrected decision), `original_claim_line_id` (denial replaced), `plan_paid` and `member_responsibility` (USD, 2 decimals), `accumulator_track` (as booked), `adjudicated_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) |
